text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day.
While walking through town with Aston Machan—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha!
A tournament to decide the champion with crown-shaped cookies, you say!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I shall be the one to devour more than anyone else!
...You ask why?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to crowns, you think of me!
After all, I'm destined to become the 'End of the Century Overlord,'
the King of Kings!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
A crown is also a charming feature
of the ultra-super mascot, Chan-Me.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I have to eat tons of cookies...
so people will think of Chan when they think of crowns!
choice_data_list: Will it affect your racing? Are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Mar-chan is in an important period right now.
Mar-chan must maintain a weight of precisely ○ carrots."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Aston Machan decided against
entering the competitive eating contest.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Of course. After all, Crown-san
must love Chan-Mei too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, after entering the crown-shaped cookie
eating contest—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As the other contestants dropped out one by one, the two kept on eating.
And then...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: F-Fufufu... You really have... quite the appetite, don't you...!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
E-Ehehe... Because, you see...
Machan is going to become... an Ultra Super Mascot...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Reaching their limits at the exact same moment,
the outcome of the battle was carried over to next time."
